benchmark_type_evidence: We introduce INDIC-DIALECT, a human-curated parallel corpus of 13k sentence pairs spanning 11 dialects and 2 languages: Hindi and Odia. Using this corpus, we construct a multi-task benchmark with three tasks: dialect classification, multiple-choice question (MCQ) answering, and machine translation (MT).
brief_description: A human-curated parallel corpus of 13,000 sentence pairs spanning 11 Indian dialects and 2 standard languages (Hindi and Odia) from three Indian states (Himachal Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh, Odisha), used to construct a multi-task benchmark evaluating dialect classification, multiple-choice question answering, and machine translation between dialects and their corresponding standard languages.
